notes.note: Scoped caller/source re-review at 5b135d618a794c07ef0b5a604d0b0aaf1a3147c1: Settings captures destination-specific Detailed intent. The primary control marks both built-ins; Advanced marks only explicitly selected destinations, accumulates selections only for the same displayed revision and author destination, and never replays an untouched Full sibling after external withdrawal. Acknowledgements are sent only for intended destinations before any corresponding config write. Shared readable details remain visible for independent Advanced Detailed selections. Canonical mounted deep links remain available inside native collapsed Advanced. These changes preserve the documented combined choice, independent Advanced choice and consent-before-delivery contracts. Settings caller tests cover both Advanced selection orders and stale sibling withdrawal; this source review does not claim live receiver, hosted or native delivery.
